newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PWI, India's Eider to set up paging firm.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PWI, India's Eider to set up paging firm.

text.p: Paging firm Philippine Wireless Inc (PWI) and Eider Electronics Ltd of India are setting up a joint venture company to operate a radio paging service in major cities in India, a PWI official said on Tuesday.
"The PWI board has given the approval to form this joint venture company which will operate in major cities of New Delhi and Calcutta," said Jose Luis Santiago, PWI chairman.
Santiago said the Eider Group will have a 51 percent stake in the joint venture firm while PWI will hold a 49 percent interest.

Aside from Eider Electronics, PWI earlier entered into a joint venture with the Usha Group to operate a paging service in middle-sized Indian cities of Coimbatore, Bhopal and Patna by the first quarter of 1997.
